issue.title: Maestro smokes: auth, navigation, record, sync/offline, edges
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

One ticket for the main Android Maestro smoke suite after foundation (#489): launch/auth, Home→drafting nav, Record happy path, Sync + Prepare for Offline, plus edges (forgot password, legal, reauth if feasible, mic/notification deny).

Prefer **multiple YAML flows / npm run targets** in one PR (or a small stacked pair only if review size forces a split — default is one PR).

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Strong ids on login/record/sync/offline; no YAML. Manual nightly QA.

**Expected:** `.maestro/flows/android/` smokes + subflows (`boot-to-login`, login, dismiss Dev Menu) with `clearState: true` for CI-shaped runs. Dedicated Maestro account on `dev.api.fluent.bible` with assignments.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Launch → login screen; login → Home; session restore; logout
- Forgot-password happy path; Privacy/Terms by id
- My Work / Projects → chapter → Bible / Resources / Record tabs
- Record: mic allow → record → stop → play (avoid destructive stage-advance on shared dev if unsafe)
- Sync Now (+ pause/resume if deterministic); Prepare-for-Offline primary controls
- Mic deny / notification deny smoke-level (no crash)
- Reauth **or** residual-documented if not automatable without backend hooks

**Out of scope**
- Multi-account isolation (see #495)
- Playbook/CI (#497)
- Auth bypass; iOS; merge-gating Maestro

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Launch + auth smokes green locally (Debug+Metro)
- [ ] Nav smoke green with assigned chapter data
- [ ] Record happy path green with mic permission
- [ ] Sync + prepare-offline primary paths green or residual-documented
- [ ] Edge flows covered or explicitly residual
- [ ] Seed/assignment prerequisites documented on PR

## Verification / test plan

1. Provision Maestro translator on hosted dev with ≥1 assignment
2. Fail-fast suite run for this ticket’s flows
3. Note flakes (post-login sync, downloads) in PR

## Links

- Refs #488
- Depends on #489
- Absorbs former nav / record / sync / edge slices
